question_text: When investigating the link between glacial melt and rising sea_____ scientists often require advanced equipment, including probes that can reach areas that no human explorer could. One such device, an agile submersible dubbed Icefin, has been instrumental in providing images of ice melt below the Thwaites Glacier. Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

When consumed as a trace component of drinking water, selenium has beneficial effects in strengthening the immune system; consumed in excess, selenium acts as a toxin. These facts are _____ ecological chemist Karen Jenni, who has traced selenium concentrations in reservoirs, particularly the Lake Koocanusa reservoir in British Columbia. Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

New research on giant kelp has revealed that this underwater plant can adapt to nutrient shortages. As a team from the University of California, Santa Barbara, discovered through combined fieldwork and lab trials, kelp thrives on two _____ and treats them as interchangeable: an ammonium shortage, for instance, is not a problem if urea is abundant. Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

Medical practitioners during the Middle Ages and the Renaissance believed that various human emotions were explained by substances or 'humours' that arose and circulated in the body. For instance, dry and chilly conditions would presumably produce a black substance _____ as bile, which presumably led to the sad condition as melancholy. Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
answer_choices: A) known, both then and now,
B) known both then and now,
C) known both then, and now,
D) known, both then and now
correct_answer: D) known, both then and now

question_text: Polynesian and Micronesian navigators resorted to stick_____ that provided information about the locations of islands and about ocean currents. In a stick chart, small pieces of coral signify island positions, and connective sticks indicate the movements of nearby swells of the Pacific Ocean. Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

The total amount the group spent on tickets and posters can be represented by the equation 4(x + 15) = 220, where x is the cost, in dollars, of one museum ticket. Which equation has the same solution as the given equation?
